sentence: This project screens small molecules to find ones that lower the protein level of a mismatch repair gene, aiming to treat Huntington's disease.
This project studies how a brain stimulation method called temporal interference works and whether it can treat epilepsy in rodent models.
This project builds a system that detects atrial fibrillation automatically and stops it quickly without pain, using battery-free bioelectronics and machine learning.
This project builds an infrared imaging system that maps the chemistry inside cells without labels, using an atomic force microscope.
This project develops optical components and systems for biomedical imaging to help understand neurobiology.
This project develops a digital measure of affective dysregulation symptoms in people with Alzheimer's disease to help detect and monitor them.
This project supplies well-characterized postmortem human brain tissue and digital slide images to support research on Alzheimer's disease and related dementias.
This project studies how changing muscle stem cells can improve muscle health.
This project studies patterns of polysubstance use over time and uses machine learning to predict who is at risk of overdose.
This project studies how the immune system defends against congenital cytomegalovirus at the boundary between mother and fetus, using rhesus macaques.
This project studies how glycosylation is regulated in hematopoietic stem cells, using single-cell measurements and mathematical modeling.
This project studies mouse strains with brain and pituitary gland development defects to understand the causes of human disease.
This project uses domain adaptation methods to build models that fill in missing pieces across biological datasets from different sequencing technologies.
This project studies which immune pathways help the adult zebrafish spinal cord regenerate after injury.
This project studies why cognitive decline differs so widely among people with Lewy body diseases, using biomarker signatures and alpha-synuclein.
This project uses Medicaid claims data to study cancers among older people with HIV.
This project develops methods to measure drug resistance in hepatitis B virus and explores how the virus works in its host.
This project engineers a vascularized porcine liver-on-a-chip that models how the human immune system responds to porcine liver xenografts.
